description:
"Thanksgiving Stuffing," Archie and Jughead have Thanksgiving dinner at Betty's, then another one at Veronica's.

"History Lesson," Reggie tries to cheat on a test.

"A Blast from the Past," Archie dreams that he's living in the 1950s.

"On the Up and Up," Different meanings of the word "up."

"Dream Queen Nightmare," Ethel is crowned the school's Dream Queen because she is kind and helpful to everyone.

• "A Ho! Ho! Hobo Christmas!", Archie takes a homeless man home with him to celebrate Christmas.
  • "Miss Grundy In The Shape Of Things," Miss Grundy asks the gang what they know about geoometry.
  • "Grab Bag Gag," Reggie rigs the grab bag at the school Christmas party.
  • "Snow Business," The gang face a rival hockey team at the local pond. reprinted in Archie & Friends Double Digest #23.
  • "Santa's Helpers," Working at Clark's department store as Santa's helpers, Archie, Jughead and Amani help out a little boy whose family is having hard times.
  • "Lunch Time!" reprinted inArchie & Friends Double Digest #23.

"Stupid Cupid Archie," Archie's Valentine's Day candy boxes get mixed up.

"Presidents' Daze," The gang all dress up as presidents and first ladies for Presidents' Day.

"Groundhog Hubbub," The gang takes a class trip to the zoo for Groundhog Day.

"Band-Aided," Archie and Reggie form competing bands.

"Talent Nightmare," The gang holds a talent show at Riverdale Junior High, but Reggie sabotages all the acts.

"Sink the Sub"; When a representative from the Book of World Records is in town, Archie and the gang try to make the world's largest sub sandwich.

"Archie's Science Project"; Archie buys some guppies for a science project.

"News Blues"; Eugene is the editor of the school newspaper and sends Archie out to find a story; As usual, Archie is oblivious to everything happening around him, but he collides with two vandals trying to flee after lighting a stink bomb, causing them to be captured and him to be called a hero.

"Substitute Santa," When Mr. Weatherbee can't play Santa Claus at a party the kids have planned for the local orphanage, Moose manages to get the real Santa to come and help.

"Snow War Won!", Eugene invents a snowball-trowing machine to help his team win against Reggie's in a big snowball fight.

"Shopping Spree Glee," Archie wins a contest that gives him five minutes in a toy store to pick out whatever he wants, and all his friends load him down with lists of toys they want him to get for them.

"A Real Good Skate!", Betty and Veronica are in a skating competition and Archie is the judge who has to admit that Veronica is the winner.
• Babysitting Blues reprinted in Archie & Friends Double Digest #23.

"Diamond and Girls," Betty is on the school baseball team, but the boys don't want her to take their position.

"Picture Perfect," While on an outing for art class, Reggie tries to ruin Archie's painting.

"The Scrub Team," Archie's class has a pet wash to raise money for charity.

"Country Cookin'", The gang decides to go out in the country for a picnic, but Jughead eats all the food on the way.

"Funny Business," Students in the Riverdale Junior Business Association have to establish an after-school business; Jughead and Betty, Reggie and Veronica, Eugene and Moose, and Archie and Amani form teams, but each of their business plans has a flaw.

"Dream Date Nightmare," Archie wins a contest for a "dream date" with TV star Glory Carter, but the dream turns into a nightmare when Glory turns out to be a selfish, media-obsessed brat.

"The April Fool," Reggie plays tricks on the rest of the gang on April Fool's day.

"Ticket to Happiness," Archie loses his ride tickets at a carnival and gives them up when he finds they were found by a couple of poor kids.

"Funny Business," Students in the Riverdale Junior Business Association have to establish an after-school business; Jughead and Betty, Reggie and Veronica, Eugene and Moose, and Archie and Amani form teams, but each of their business plans has a flaw.

"Ticket to Happiness," Archie loses his ride tickets at a carnival and gives them up when he finds they were found by a couple of poor kids.

The West Coast Avengers are no more, but Iron Man has plans of his own for a new team, and a new philosophy! They will actively prevent disasters before they happen, rather than stopping them. They are…Force Works!

Iron Man, brings Spider-Woman, USAgent, Scarlet Witch, and Wonder Man together to form Force Works. He shows them there new headquarters, The Works. Everything seem to be going well but when Scarlet Witch and Wonder Man go back to the old Avengers West headquarters and run into Vision and the Black Widow, things go bad quickly.

The Kree attack the four heroes and use a ray to debilitate Vision and Wonder Man. Wonder Man takes off for the Kree's mother ship in orbit. The rest of the Force Works team shows up and Scarlet Witch uses her Hex powers, and they summon Century, who helps fight back the Kree.

In space Wonder Man turns off the Kree's ray, but when two space pods destroy the ship it appears that Wonder Man is killed. Back on earth more pods land near the Force Works team, and the Scatter emerge. They teleport away with Spider-Woman, USAgent and Scarlet Witch, leaving Iron Man, with a confused Century, wondering how everything went wrong so quickly.
Force Works and Dreamguard continue their deadly battle with the creature known only as the Orphan! Plus, a who's who of Marvel heroes remembers their fallen comrade, Wonder Man.
Black Brigade has returned, and he won't stop until he exacts his revenge on every member of Force Works! His first target - Julia Carpenter, aka Spider-Woman!

The Slorenian villains continue their campaign of revenge on Force Works, until Iron Man decides it's time to get a little payback for the payback! Plus, a back up adventure starring War Machine!

Includes Brothers in Arms #1 on the flipside.
Force Works teams up with Earth's Mightiest Heroes - the Avengers! The heroes take the fight to the Kree cabal called Starstealth, to get revenge for the death of Wonder Man!
The payback for Wonder Man comes down to this! The combined strength of Force Works and the Avengers against the alien might of the Kree enforcers known as Starstealth! Who will come out on top?
A mysterious new evil has attacked Force Works, and only US Agent and Century remain standing to save them! But can they even trust one another?

Spider-Woman and Moonraker welcome the Scarlet Witch and the U.S. Agent from New York, but a series of unexplained time rifts complicates things.

Moonraker makes his first appearance, although everyone on the teams to know for quite some time, except for Rachel Carpenter who never remembers seeing him until this issue.
Amid the team's induction of Cybermancer as their newest member, Iron Man shares some distressing news about the death of Marilla.

Force Works draws the gaze of Apocryphus when they land in Vietnam to find the Temple of Agaphaur.

Rachel Carpenter tells Cybermancer and Amanda Chaney that she knows where Viet Nam since everyone else seems not to know if that country really exists. Scarlet Witch, Moonraker and Spider Woman are attaked by Apocryphus. War Machine, U.S.Agent, Black Widow and Hawkeye discuss about the change they see in Tony Stark.

Hawkeye reaches out to Black Widow, U.S. Agent and War Machine to help them track down Iron Man and stop Kang.

Iron Man kills Amanda Chaney in this issue.

The unthinkable has happened - Wonder Man has fallen! And his replacement raises more questions than answers! Who is the enigmatic Century?

Iron Man meets the mysterious alien know as Century, and Force Works prepare to battle the Scatter.
V.I.R.G.I.L. deploys holo-constructs against the Force Works team, forcing Daniels and the Scarlet Witch to find a way to disrupt their main power source!
In the aftermath of Avengers: Timeslide, Force Works faces the fact that the team is finished. But how will they respond to the Avenger's pressures?

FINAL ISSUE! In the aftermath of "The Crossing," Force Works attempts to rebuild, but is the damage -- to the HQ, to the team, to their lives -- too much to repair? This concluding issue holds all the answers that will reverberate in upcoming issues of THE AVENGERS.

NOTE: The original solicitation had Heitor Oliveira as the penciler, of this issue.
Force Works' baptism of fire isn't over yet! The new team has their hands full when taking on a mysterious alien race known only as the Scatter!
Force Works is a long way from home helping to quell a Slorenian civil war, but the problems really being to flare up when the powerful and savage creature known as Ember joins the fray!
The fight in Slorenia takes a surprising turn, when Force Works is suddenly betrayed by the Slorenian Black Brigade! Can the team survive a two-pronged atttack?

issue_title: Hands of the Mandarin, Part 1 of 6: Good Bye Hong Kong
description:
HANDS OF THE MANDARIN tie-in! The team faces off against the deadly forces of the Mandarin!

The Mandarin's new super-team attacks Force Works in Hong Kong. Seemingly, War Machine and Century are slain.

issue_title: Hands of the Mandarin Part 4 of 6: Hearts of Darkness
description: HANDS OF THE MANDARIN tie-in! Force Works may be beaten, but not beaten down! The team rallies to once again fight off Mandarin's Avatars!
Tis the season for Force Works! In this special holiday issue, the team is planning a big X-mas bash, but they'll have to deal with a surprise gate-crasher!
The Force Works team finds themselves traveling down under to face a mysterious monster! But they won't be alone, as they're joined by a new hero: Dreamguard!
